properties.description: Requirement A (req:a-design-holds-a-line-of-reasoning), built 2026-10-16 in reflow2-core's reasoning module and served as reasoning_report. It walks from one claim, or from every top conclusion and every `contested` Decision, following a step's premises, the objections against each node, and the sides a contested Decision governs. Cited sources (an Artifact that DOCUMENTS a claim) and corroboration are listed, never walked. Every reply carries what_this_means: structure is not truth, a source counts only when the design names it, and nothing in it is legal, medical or other professional advice. Bounded by budget_chars. A claim with no support is listed here and raises no gap (con:no-gap-is-raised-for-a-conclusion-that-has-no-inference).
properties.name: reasoning_report reads a line of reasoning back: each claim with its computed truth, support, objections and cited sources; what it rests on; the points still contested and those contested by design; every claim with no support; and what its checks mean
